Ministry: Department of Women Development and Social Welfare and Child Development (DWD), Government of West Bengal
Description: A conditional cash transfer scheme to improve the life and status of girls by helping them pursue higher education and preventing early marriages.
Eligibility: Girls aged 13-18 years; must be unmarried; must be enrolled in an educational institution; family income should be less than Rs. 1.20 Lakh per annum.
Benefits: K1: Annual grant of Rs. 1,000. K2: One-time grant of Rs. 25,000 upon turning 18.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Birth Certificate, Unmarried Declaration, Bank Account Details, Income Certificate.

Scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
Ministry: National Health Authority (NHA) under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Description: The world's largest government-funded healthcare program providing financial protection at primary, secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
Eligibility: Families identified through the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 for rural and urban categories, along with other beneficiaries as notified by participating States/UTs. Eligibility depends on deprivation, occupation, or state-specific inclusion criteria.
Benefits: Health insurance cover of up to Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per year. Provides cashless and paperless access to hospital services.
Document_Required: Aadhaar (where applicable), PM-JAY e-card/Ayushman Card, ration card or other identity/address documents as required for verification.

Ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Description: A central sector scheme providing direct income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs for agriculture and allied activities.
Eligibility: All landholding farmers' families (husband, wife, and minor children) who own cultivable land as per state/UT land records. (Note: Higher economic status individuals and income tax payers are excluded).
Benefits: An amount of ?6,000/- per year in 3 equal installments of ?2,000/- every four months is provided to each eligible family.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Active Bank Account (Aadhar seeded), Land ownership records (Khatauni).

Description: A government-backed small savings scheme targeted at the parents of a girl child, designed to build a dedicated fund for her future education and marriage expenses.
Eligibility: A government-backed small savings scheme targeted at the parents of a girl child, designed to build a dedicated fund for her future education and marriage expenses.
Benefits: Offers a high interest rate, tax deductions under Section 80C (up to Rs. 1.5 Lakh), and the final maturity amount is completely tax-free.
Document_Required: Birth Certificate of the girl child, Aadhar Card and PAN Card of the parent/guardian.

Description: A flagship scheme to provide collateral-free micro-credit facilities to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro-enterprises to promote entrepreneurship.
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income-generating activity (like manufacturing, trading, or services) and requires loan support up to Rs. 10 Lakh.
Benefits: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income-generating activity (like manufacturing, trading, or services) and requires loan support up to Rs. 10 Lakh.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Proof of Business Identity/Address, Bank Statement, and Passport-size photographs.

Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (Urban) / Ministry of Rural Development (Gramin)
Description: A flagship housing scheme launched to provide affordable, all-weather 'pucca' houses with basic amenities to eligible homeless families and those living in dilapidated houses.
Eligibility: The beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Beneficiaries are categorized into EWS (Economically Weaker Section), LIG, and MIG based on income. A female family member must be a co-owner of the property.
Benefits: Upfront financial assistance for house construction, plus massive interest subsidies on home loans (up to Rs. 2.67 Lakh) under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Income Certificate, PAN Card, Bank Statement, and a Declaration of not owning a pucca house.

Ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development (in collaboration with Health & Education ministries)
Description: A nationwide campaign aimed at addressing the declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and promoting the empowerment of girls through education and life-cycle support.
Eligibility: This is a universal campaign for the entire community. It specifically targets districts with low sex ratios to change social mindsets.
Benefits: Generates mass public awareness regarding the importance of the girl child, improves access to welfare services for girls, and strengthens educational and health infrastructure for gender equality.
Document_Required: Not applicable for direct cash (Since it's a social campaign, but school enrollments under it require Birth Certificate and Aadhar).

Description: Facilitates bank loans to encourage entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and women by funding new (greenfield) enterprises.
Eligibility: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs above 18 years of age. The loan is strictly for setting up a new enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or the trading sector.
Benefits: Collateral-free bank loans ranging from Rs. 10 Lakh to Rs. 1 Crore.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Project/Business Plan, and Bank Statement.

Ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Description: A major social welfare initiative to provide clean cooking fuel (LPG) to women belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) and marginalized households, protecting them from the health hazards of traditional cooking fuels.
Eligibility: An adult woman belonging to a BPL family, SC/ST household, or Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) beneficiary. There must not be any other active LPG connection in the same household.
Benefits: Financial support of Rs. 1,600 for a new LPG connection, along with a free first cylinder refill and a free gas stove (hotplate).
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, BPL Ration Card, Bank Account Details, and a Passport-size photograph.

Description: A government-backed pension scheme primarily aimed at the unorganized sector to provide a guaranteed minimum income and financial security during old age.
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen between the ages of 18 and 40 years who has a valid savings bank account or post office savings account.
Benefits: A guaranteed minimum monthly pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 upon reaching the age of 60, depending on the contribution amount and age of joining.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card and an Active Bank Account (to set up auto-debit for monthly contributions).

Scheme_name: PM YASASVI (PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India)
Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Description: A scholarship scheme designed to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-Notified Tribes (DNT) for pursuing higher education.
Eligibility: OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Class 9 or 11 in identified top schools. The parents' annual income should not exceed Rs. 2.5 Lakhs.
Benefits: Full tuition fees and non-refundable charges are covered. The scheme provides up to Rs. 2,00,000 per annum for private sector institutions and up to Rs. 3,72,000 annually for specific elite institutions.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Income Certificate, Caste Certificate, and School Identity Card.

Ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Description: A flagship skill certification scheme aimed at enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training to help them secure better livelihoods.
Eligibility: Any Indian national possessing a valid Aadhar, aged between 15 and 45 years. It targets school/college dropouts, unemployed youth, and individuals looking to upskill.
Benefits: Free short-duration skill training courses (ranging from 300 to 600 hours) with On-the-Job Training (OJT) components and official certification upon completion.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Educational Certificates, and Passport-size photographs.

Ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
Description: A central sector scheme providing end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople (like carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths) to scale their businesses.
Eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople engaged in traditional trades at the unorganized sector level. The beneficiary must be at least 18 years old.
Benefits: Collateral-free credit, free skill training, advanced modern tools, incentives for digital transactions, and market linkage support.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Mobile Number (Aadhar linked), Bank Account Details, and Ration Card.

Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Description: A special micro-credit facility to provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods post-pandemic.
Eligibility: Street vendors who have been operating their businesses in urban areas prior to March 24, 2020.
Benefits: Collateral-free working capital loans starting at Rs. 15,000 (1st Tranche), Rs. 25,000 (2nd Tranche), and Rs. 50,000 (3rd Tranche) with interest subsidies for timely repayments.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Voter ID (or driving license), Certificate of Vending/Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies.

Description: A national mission for financial inclusion to ensure access to financial services like basic savings accounts, remittances, credit, insurance, and pension in an affordable manner.
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen who does not have any other existing bank account. Minors above 10 years can also open accounts.
Benefits: A zero-balance bank account, a free RuPay debit card, an inbuilt accident insurance cover of Rs. 2 Lakh, and an overdraft facility of up to Rs. 10,000.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card (or any valid officially valid document like Voter ID, PAN, MGNREGA card).

Description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.
Eligibility: Startups recognized by DPIIT, incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application, and offering a tech-based innovative solution.
Benefits: Seed funding up to Rs. 20 Lakhs for validation/proof of concept, and up to Rs. 50 Lakhs for market entry and scaling.
Document_Required: Seed funding up to Rs. 20 Lakhs for validation/proof of concept, and up to Rs. 50 Lakhs for market entry and scaling.

Description: A pan-India, short-term recruitment scheme for Indian youth to serve in the Armed Forces as "Agniveers".
Eligibility: Indian citizens between the ages of 17.5 and 21 years (educational criteria varies based on specific trades, mostly 10th or 12th pass).
Benefits: A 4-year tenure in the Armed Forces with a customized monthly package, plus a one-time 'Seva Nidhi' package of approximately Rs. 11.71 Lakhs upon completion. 25% of Agniveers will be enrolled in the regular cadre.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Class 10/12 Marksheets, Domicile Certificate, and Medical Fitness Certificate.

Scheme_name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
Description: Provides hot cooked meals to school children to improve their nutritional status and encourage school enrollment and attendance.
Eligibility: All children studying in Classes 1 to 8 in Government and Government-aided schools, as well as Balvatikas (pre-primary classes).
Benefits: One hot cooked nutritious meal every school day for eligible children.
Document_Required: School Enrollment (No specific documents needed from children for the meal itself).

Description: A non-contributory pension scheme that provides social security to elderly citizens living below the poverty line.
Eligibility: The applicant must be 60 years or higher and must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
Benefits: A monthly pension of Rs. 200 for those aged 60-79 years, and Rs. 500 for those aged 80 years and above. (States often add their own contribution to this amount).
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Age Proof, BPL Ration Card, and Bank Account Details.

Scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Description: A highly accessible, one-year life insurance scheme renewable from year to year, offering coverage for death due to any reason.
Eligibility: Individuals in the age group of 18 to 50 years having a savings bank or post office account.
Benefits: A life cover of Rs. 2 Lakhs payable to the nominee in case of the subscriber's death, at a minimal premium of just Rs. 436 per annum.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card and an Active Bank Account with auto-debit consent.

Description: A scholarship scheme designed to empower young women by providing them financial assistance to pursue technical education (Degree or Diploma).
Eligibility: Up to two girls per family. The applicant must be admitted to the first or second year of a technical degree/diploma program at an AICTE-approved institution. Family income must be less than Rs. 8 Lakhs per annum.
Benefits: A scholarship of Rs. 50,000 per annum for every year of study to cover tuition, books, and equipment.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, 10th/12th Marksheets, Income Certificate, and Admission Letter.

Scheme_name: KIRAN (Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing)
Description: Encourages women in the field of Science and Technology, specifically providing opportunities for women scientists who had a break in their careers to return to research.
Eligibility: Women scientists and technologists between the ages of 27 and 57 years who have a break in their career and wish to return to mainstream science.
Benefits: Monthly stipends ranging from Rs. 31,000 to Rs. 55,000 and research grants for pursuing projects in applied sciences, engineering, and agriculture.
Document_Required: Post-Graduate/Ph.D. Degrees, Aadhar Card, and a detailed Project Proposal.

Description: A program providing skill training to fresh graduates, diploma holders, and vocational certificate holders in engineering and non-engineering fields.
Eligibility: Indian citizens holding a Degree/Diploma in Engineering or Technology, or a BA/BSc/BCom degree, passed out within the last 3-5 years.
Benefits: 1-year practical on-the-job training at reputed organizations with a guaranteed monthly stipend (Rs. 8,000 to Rs. 9,000) paid partially by the government.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Degree/Diploma Certificates, Bank Account Details, and Passport-size photo.

Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Description: A comprehensive crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers in the event of crop failure due to natural calamities, pests, or diseases.
Eligibility: All farmers (including sharecroppers and tenant farmers) growing notified crops in notified areas.
Benefits: Maximum insurance coverage at minimum premium rates (1.5% to 2% for Kharif/Rabi crops, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops).
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Land Records (Khatauni), Bank Passbook, and Sowing Certificate.

Description: A digital health initiative to create a seamless online platform integrating digital health records, registries of providers, and health facilities.
Eligibility: Any Indian citizen can voluntarily participate and create their ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) number.
Benefits: Citizens get a 14-digit ABHA number to digitally store and share their medical records, prescriptions, and diagnostic reports securely with doctors and hospitals nationwide.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card or Mobile Number.

Description: A framework to elevate wireless internet connectivity in the country by setting up public Wi-Fi networks through Public Data Offices (PDOs).
Eligibility: Open to all citizens for usage. (Local shopkeepers and small businesses can become PDOs without any license fee).
Benefits: Citizens get access to high-speed, affordable internet in public spaces. PDOs get an additional source of income by selling internet data.
Document_Required: PM-WANI App installation (for users).

Description: A one-time small savings scheme specifically for women and girls to encourage investments and financial independence.
Eligibility: Can be opened by any woman for herself, or by a guardian on behalf of a minor girl.
Benefits: Offers a fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded quarterly for a maximum tenure of 2 years. Maximum deposit allowed is Rs. 2 Lakhs.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, PAN Card, and KYC form at a Post Office or Bank.

Description: A placement-linked skill development program aimed at transforming rural poor youth into an economically independent and globally relevant workforce.
Eligibility: Rural youth belonging to poor families (BPL/MGNREGA workers' households) between the ages of 15 and 35 years.
Benefits: Free skill training, free lodging/boarding, uniforms, and guaranteed placement assistance with a minimum wage post-training.
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, BPL Card/Income Proof, and Educational Certificates.

Ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Agriculture
Description: Provides farmers with timely and adequate credit support from the banking system under a single window with flexible and simplified procedures.
Eligibility: All farmers (individuals/joint borrowers), tenant farmers, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) involved in agriculture, fisheries, and animal husbandry.
Benefits: Short-term credit limits to meet agricultural expenses, post-harvest expenses, and consumption requirements at highly subsidized interest rates (often effectively 4% with prompt repayment).
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Land holding documents, and Passport-size photo.

Description: A national campaign to eliminate open defecation and improve solid and liquid waste management in rural areas.
Eligibility: BPL households and identified Above Poverty Line (APL) households restricted to SCs/STs, small and marginal farmers, landless laborers, and women-headed households.
Benefits: Financial incentive of Rs. 12,000 for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL).
Document_Required: Financial incentive of Rs. 12,000 for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL).

Description: Government securities denominated in grams of gold, offering an alternative to holding physical gold, paying a fixed interest rate.
Eligibility: Resident individuals, Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), trusts, universities, and charitable institutions.
Benefits: Resident individuals, Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), trusts, universities, and charitable institutions.
Document_Required: PAN Card (Mandatory), Aadhar Card, and Bank Account.

Description: Provides financial assistance to meritorious students belonging to minority communities to pursue higher education from Class 11 up to Ph.D. level.
Eligibility: Students from minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) with at least 50% marks in the previous final exam. Family income must not exceed Rs. 2 Lakhs per annum.
Benefits: Covers admission and tuition fees, plus a maintenance allowance (ranging from Rs. 380 to Rs. 1,200 per month depending on the course and hosteler status).
Document_Required: Aadhar Card, Previous Marksheets, Income Certificate, and Community Certificate.

Description: A poverty alleviation project aimed at creating effective institutional platforms for the rural poor, enabling them to increase household income through sustainable livelihood enhancements.
Eligibility: Rural poor women, primarily mobilized into Self Help Groups (SHGs). At least one woman member from each identified rural poor household.
Benefits: Provides revolving funds, community investment support funds, and bank linkages to SHGs to start micro-enterprises and escape poverty.
Document_Required: BPL Status / SECC 2011 Database inclusion, Aadhar Card, and Bank Account (for the SHG).

Ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
Description: An AI-driven language translation platform to bridge the language barrier in India by providing digital services and voice-based internet access in local Indian languages.
Eligibility: Open to all citizens. Tech developers and startups can access its APIs, and citizens can contribute local language data (Bhasha Daan).
Benefits: Seamless translation of documents and websites, and voice-to-voice translation in real-time for digital empowerment.
Document_Required: No specific documents required for usage.

Description: A major national program designed to facilitate investment, foster innovation, enhance skill development, and build best-in-class manufacturing infrastructure in the country.
Eligibility: Domestic and foreign manufacturing companies, startups, and entrepreneurs across 27 identified sectors (e.g., aerospace, IT, auto).
Benefits: Tax incentives, eased foreign direct investment (FDI) norms, intellectual property protection, and Production Linked Incentives (PLI) for scaling manufacturing.
Document_Required: Company Incorporation Certificate, DPIIT Recognition (for startups), and sector-specific project proposals.
